type_constraints.description: vectors.distance enum restricted to Cosine|Euclid|Dot|Manhattan (Distance schema enum)
vectors.size is uint64 integer
inferred: invalid vectors config value rejected as 400 JSON format error (runtime observed: data did not match any variant of untagged enum VectorsConfig on distance:Bogus)
type_constraints.assertion: vectors with invalid enum value => HTTP 400 Format error in JSON body

type_constraints.description: quantization compression enum values x4|x8|x16|x32|x64 (CompressionRatio)
type_constraints.assertion: quantization_config.product.compression IN {x4, x8, x16, x32, x64}

type_constraints.description: scalar quantization type enum is int8 only; quantile range [0.5, 1.0]
binary quantization encoding enum one_bit|two_bits|one_and_half_bits
vector datatype enum float32|uint8|float16|turbo4; turbo4 dense-only
type_constraints.assertion: datatype IN {float32, uint8, float16, turbo4}; turbo4 NOT allowed for sparse vectors

type_constraints.description: inferred: sparse vector distance is always Dot and not user-settable
type_constraints.assertion: sparse_vectors.*.distance NOT settable; sparse distance == Dot

type_constraints.description: sparse vectors must be named and must not share names with dense vectors
type_constraints.assertion: sparse vector config requires a name; sparse/dense names disjoint

type_constraints.description: all vectors within one collection must share the same dimensionality per vector name
type_constraints.assertion: vectors in collection have consistent size per vector name

type_constraints.description: sharding_method enum auto|custom|hash_slot (default auto)
point id oneOf uint64 integer | UUID string
type_constraints.assertion: PointStruct.id IS uint64 OR uuid string

type_constraints.description: ordering enum weak|medium|strong (Allowed values on doc page)
sparse vector body {indices:[uint], values:[float]}
uint8 dense vectors are integers in range 0..255
PayloadSchemaType enum keyword|integer|float|geo|text|bool|datetime|uuid
type_constraints.assertion: field_schema type IN {keyword, integer, float, geo, text, bool, datetime, uuid}

type_constraints.description: text index tokenizer enum prefix|whitespace|word|multilingual
strategy enum average_vector|best_score|sum_scores, default average_vector
priority enum no_sync|snapshot|replica
Filter clause structure {should?, min_should?, must?, must_not?}, recursively nestable
is_empty matches field missing OR null OR []; is_null matches field exists with null value; NULL not testable via match
type_constraints.assertion: is_empty := field in {missing, null, []}; is_null := field exists and value null

type_constraints.description: inferred: nested condition: has_id and slice not supported inside nested filter
type_constraints.assertion: has_id, slice NOT allowed inside nested filter

range_constraints.description: acorn_scale in [0.0, 1.0], default 0.4 (acorn disabled by default)
sample >= 2 (default 10): how many points to select and search within
limit >= 1 (default 3): how many neighbours per sample to find
facet limit >= 1, default 10 (doc page: Max number of hits to return. Default is 10.)
inferred: max_resident_memory_percent / max_disk_usage_percent in [1,100]; release_margin_percent in [0,100]; null = not capped
range_constraints.assertion: max_resident_memory_percent IN [1,100] AND max_disk_usage_percent IN [1,100] AND release_margin_percent IN [0,100]

range_constraints.description: amount of non-zero values in sparse vectors limited to u32 range (4294967295)
group_size >= 1 (default 3) and limit >= 1 (default 10) for query groups

state_constraints.description: inferred: creating a collection with an existing name fails (runtime observed conflict; spec: 4xx)
state_constraints.assertion: PUT existing collection_name => HTTP 4xx conflict

state_constraints.description: get of non-existent collection returns 404 Not found: Collection ... doesn't exist! (runtime verified)
state_constraints.assertion: GET unknown collection => HTTP 404

state_constraints.description: inferred: 1.18: index/quantization/disk config changeable post-create without recreating; vector-space-defining properties (size/distance of existing named vector) not alterable via update
state_constraints.assertion: PATCH can change hnsw/quantization/disk config; PATCH cannot change size/distance of existing named vector

state_constraints.description: deleting non-existent collection returns 404; deleting existing collection returns 200 (runtime verified)
state_constraints.assertion: DELETE existing => 200; DELETE missing => 404

state_constraints.description: inferred: default upsert is insert-or-update by id (update_mode insert_only/update_only variants exist SDK-side)
state_constraints.assertion: upsert by existing id replaces point; new id inserts

state_constraints.description: inferred: delete by filter can wipe whole collection if filter matches all; delete of non-existent ids is idempotent success
state_constraints.assertion: delete missing ids => 200 (no error)

state_constraints.description: batch update operations are executed in order; operations include upsert/set_payload/overwrite_payload/delete_payload/clear_payload/delete_points/update_vectors/delete_vectors
state_constraints.assertion: batch operations execute sequentially in submitted order

state_constraints.description: inferred: set payload requires points OR filter to identify targets; both null is an error
state_constraints.assertion: points == null AND filter == null => error

state_constraints.description: overwrite payload replaces entire payload of targeted points (missing keys removed)
state_constraints.assertion: overwrite_payload: result payload == submitted payload exactly

state_constraints.description: update-vectors updates only the specified named vectors; unspecified vectors unchanged
state_constraints.assertion: update_vectors: unspecified named vectors remain unchanged

state_constraints.description: payload-based order_by requires a payload index supporting Range filtering conditions on that field, otherwise request rejected
state_constraints.assertion: order_by without range-capable payload index => request rejected

state_constraints.description: pagination via next_page_offset in response; exhausted when null
state_constraints.assertion: next_page_offset == null when no more pages

state_constraints.description: groups API does not allow offset pagination
state_constraints.assertion: groups request with offset => rejected/ignored

state_constraints.description: inferred: by-id query fetches stored vector from that point; fetched vectors must match characteristics of the using vector otherwise error
state_constraints.assertion: query by id with mismatched using-vector characteristics => error

state_constraints.description: pagination (offset) not enabled when using groups: offset parameter not allowed
state_constraints.assertion: groups + offset => not allowed

state_constraints.description: facet only works on a field with a payload index that supports MatchValue conditions (like a keyword index)
state_constraints.assertion: facet on field without MatchValue-capable index => error

state_constraints.description: inferred: deleting a non-existent index succeeds (idempotent 200); deleting index does not delete data
state_constraints.assertion: DELETE unknown field index => 200

state_constraints.description: integer index assumes lookup=true AND range=true by default; range=false with range filters may degrade performance
state_constraints.assertion: integer index defaults lookup=true, range=true

state_constraints.description: alias changes are atomic: no collection modifications can happen between alias operations
state_constraints.assertion: alias operations applied atomically

state_constraints.description: shard keys require collection created with sharding_method=custom; existing data not retro-sharded
state_constraints.assertion: create shard key on non-custom collection => 400

state_constraints.description: deleting a shard key that still holds points fails; key must be emptied first
state_constraints.assertion: delete shard key with points => 400

state_constraints.description: inferred: write=true blocks all mutation APIs; blocked writes return error with configured error_message
state_constraints.assertion: locked collection mutation => error containing error_message

assertions.description: invalid vectors config enum gives 400 with JSON format error
assertions.category: HTTP 400, Format error in JSON body: data did not match any variant of untagged enum VectorsConfig

assertions.description: 200 CollectionOperationResponse {result, status ok, time} on success
GET collection returns full config incl. resolved defaults
assertions.category: HTTP 200 CollectionsInfo with config, status green|yellow|red, points_count

assertions.description: existence endpoint never 404s for missing collection; existence expressed in body
list collections returns array of {name} descriptions
with wait=false client receives acknowledge-only response immediately; eventual consistency before searchable
assertions.category: response status acknowledged; data may not be retrievable yet

assertions.description: by default payload and vector are NOT returned; must opt in with with_payload/with_vector
assertions.category: 200 records without payload/vector unless opted in; missing ids absent from result, not an error

assertions.description: single point get: 404 if point or collection does not exist
assertions.category: HTTP 404 on missing point or collection

assertions.description: count with exact=true gives exact count; 200 {count}; 404 collection missing
delete points: 200 ok; 404 collection; 400 invalid filter
HNSW pagination non-deterministic: same point can repeat across pages or points skipped; exact=true gives stable deterministic ordering for offset pagination
assertions.category: approximate search: duplicates/skips across pages possible; exact search: stable order

assertions.description: large offset values may cause performance issues; offset internally retrieves offset+limit points
assertions.category: offset pagination cost grows linearly with offset (by-design)

assertions.description: legacy search: 400 on dim mismatch or invalid vector name
recommend: 400 when positive references a point without the used vector or missing point
assertions.category: HTTP 400 when positive id lacks used vector

assertions.description: Cosine similarity implemented as dot-product over normalized vectors; vectors automatically normalized during upload (by-design)
assertions.category: vector -> Cosine collection: stored vectors normalized; cross-type distance ops succeed by-design

assertions.description: optimizer status per shard; 404 missing collection

behavioral_contracts.description: points visible to search/retrieve after upsert with wait=true
behavioral_contracts.scenario: create collection; upsert point with wait=true; query nearest with same vector
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: upserted point appears in query results (top hit with distance ~0 for identical vector)

behavioral_contracts.description: deleted points are not returned by search or retrieve
behavioral_contracts.scenario: upsert point; delete it by id; query/retrieve the id
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: retrieve point => 404; search no longer returns the point

behavioral_contracts.description: update-vectors changes only specified named vectors; retrieval returns new values
behavioral_contracts.scenario: upsert point with named vectors; update_vectors with new values for one name
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: get point returns updated vector for changed name; other vectors unchanged

behavioral_contracts.description: deleting a collection removes its points; other collections unaffected
behavioral_contracts.scenario: two collections with points; delete one
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: deleted collection GET => 404; other collection count unchanged

behavioral_contracts.description: alias operations are atomic; queries via alias route to target collection
behavioral_contracts.scenario: create collections a and b; create alias x -> a; rename alias x -> b
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: no point in time where alias x is missing or ambiguous; queries via x hit b after rename

state_invariants.description: after successful create, GET collection returns 200 with config
state_invariants.assertion: create => 200 THEN collections+get => 200 with status in {green,yellow,red}

state_invariants.description: after successful delete, GET collection returns 404
upserting N unique new points yields count == N (exact)
state_invariants.assertion: upsert N unique ids THEN points+count(exact=true).count == N

state_invariants.description: deleting M of N points yields count == N-M
state_invariants.assertion: delete M ids THEN count == N - M

state_invariants.description: re-upserting an existing id replaces the point (count unchanged)
state_invariants.assertion: upsert existing id THEN count unchanged

state_invariants.description: overwrite payload leaves exactly the submitted payload
state_invariants.assertion: overwrite_payload(p) THEN get point payload == p

data_types.name: PointId
data_types.description: oneOf 64-bit unsigned integer | UUID string; UUID usable in every request

data_types.name: DenseVector
data_types.description: fixed-length float array matching collection size; float32 default

data_types.name: SparseVector
data_types.description: no fixed length, dynamically allocated; non-zero values limited to u32 range (4294967295); distance always Dot

data_types.name: Multivector
data_types.description: matrix of same-shaped dense vectors; requires multivector_config comparator max_sim; single combined score per point

data_types.name: VectorParams
data_types.description: dense vector space definition per vector name

data_types.name: HnswConfig
data_types.description: m=16, ef_construct=100, full_scan_threshold=10000 (KB), max_indexing_threads=0, on_disk=false defaults in v1.18.0; ef_construct min 4; m min 0

data_types.name: OptimizersConfig
data_types.description: deleted_threshold=0.2, vacuum_min_vector_number=1000, indexing_threshold=10000 KB defaults; below indexing_threshold vectors stay in plain index (small collections may have NO HNSW segment by design)

data_types.name: WalConfig
data_types.description: wal_capacity_mb=32, wal_segments_ahead=0, wal_retain_closed=1 defaults in v1.18.0

data_types.name: SearchParams
data_types.description: hnsw_ef min 1; exact default false; indexed_only default false; acorn_scale 0.0-1.0 default 0.4

data_types.name: WriteOrderingType
data_types.description: weak | medium | strong; weak default (may reorder writes)

data_types.name: ReadConsistency
data_types.description: majority | quorum | all, or integer N replicas queried

data_types.name: QuotaConfig
data_types.description: node-wide quotas; percent fields [1,100] (release margin [0,100]); enforced only while enabled=true

data_types.name: PayloadIndexSchema
data_types.description: PayloadSchemaType keyword|integer|float|geo|text|bool|datetime|uuid; text tokenizer prefix|whitespace|word|multilingual; integer lookup/range default true
